THE PROBLEM

Less searching.
More listening.

Finding the right audio story takes repeated searches and trial and error. We bring language, story type and your preferences together to help you choose faster.

OUR VISION

A discovery companion
that understands you.

Starting with Bengali stories, we aim to connect listeners with stories and creators they might otherwise miss.

How recommendations will work

AI will help describe story themes and mood during catalog preparation. A person will review the tags. The browser will then filter and rank the catalog using your preferences and feedback.

This prototype uses title keywords and your confirmed favorites. It does not yet use AI-reviewed tags. Duration and current video availability are unverified; YouTube links let you check the originals.

How we plan to sustain the service

We plan to start with free discovery. Future options include premium discovery tools, clearly labeled editorial sponsorships, disclosed affiliate partnerships and creator services. These are proposed models. Payment will not buy organic recommendation positions, and YouTube playback will remain freely accessible.
